intro: We do not publish package prices, because a roofing price quoted without seeing the roof is a guess. Square footage, pitch, how many layers have to come off, the condition of the decking underneath and the shingle line you pick all move the number, sometimes by thousands. What we will commit to is this: the estimate is free, it is itemized so you can see where the money goes, there is no obligation attached to it, and we will match a comparable quote from another contractor. Take our number and go get a second one — we would rather you compare than wonder.
notes: One thing worth knowing before you collect quotes anywhere: Pennsylvania requires any contractor performing home-improvement work over $500 to register with the Office of Attorney General, and the registry is public and searchable. Be cautious of a contractor who wants a large cash deposit before materials are ordered, offers a price that expires today, or will only describe the workmanship warranty verbally. Ask every contractor you talk to — including us — for the workmanship terms in writing, separate from the manufacturer's material warranty.
